title: Feather Color
paragraphs: “Oh? Father, good morning.”
“Burned out… Completely white…”

I moved closer to Father and waved my hand a few times. He’s mumbling something to himself, but there’s no response. He said the same thing to Éclair before, but now he’s doing it himself. As expected of Father, he’s thorough in a way that’s impressive.
But is he okay? Yes, I should go get him some water or something. Just as I was about to step away…
“Ah… ugh…”
The panda let out a groan. Father snapped out of it and looked toward the panda.
“W-what an unbelievable experience…”
“I-I’m sorry…”
Father was bowing his head repeatedly to the panda. What’s going on here?
“Well…”
The panda grabbed Father’s shoulder as if to say not to worry and shook his head.
“I… my first time… that…”
“Don’t worry about it. Sure, I was a little shocked, but I had plenty of chances to escape, and in the end, I just went with the flow. It’s my fault.”
The panda let out a deep sigh. Watching that, Father spoke.
“I-I’ll take responsibility, I swear.”
“No need. Don’t worry about it, just forget it!”
“Seriously…” The panda crossed his arms and grumbled.
It seems something happened between Father and them after that.
“An orgy of lust… huh.”
“I never thought Sadeena-san would actually go through with it…”
“If I don’t get a grip, I’ll keep getting swept along. Tonight, I’m definitely finding a way to escape!”
“Yeah. I remember Sadeena-san saying something ominous about this being just the beginning, and I saw her buried in some of those kinds of books.”
It seems Father and the panda have been deepening their friendship. It’s good that they’re getting along.
“She was saying things like, ‘I’ll teach you the pleasures not just of demi-humans, but of beastmen too…’ And yeah, she actually transformed midway through…”
Father hugged his elbows and trembled, and this time, the panda comforted him.
“Well, as the Shield Hero, maybe it’s not a bad idea for you to get used to beastmen.”
“Larsa?”
“Ah… no, never mind, don’t worry about it!”
The panda, slightly blushing, seemed to be trying to console Father. But Father tilted his head in confusion.
“Right… um… Larsa, you were really cute.”
“Y-you’re saying that here!? Forget it! Forget it or I’ll kill you!”
Teasing the panda seems to be one of Father’s hobbies. The heavy atmosphere from earlier lightened up. After that, Father and the panda continued their comedic banter for a while.
The panda’s expression brightened as if everything was back to normal. That’s just the kind of relationship they have. Eventually, Father scratched his head with a troubled look and spoke.
“I like Sadeena-san, but… what’s going to happen from now on…”
“If you had really resisted, that viper would’ve backed off, wouldn’t she?”
“Do you… think so?”
“But maybe that viper is better at making sure there’s an escape route while not actually letting you get away.”
The panda and Father both let out a sigh at the same time. Synchronized like that… they really are getting along well.
“In the end, it’s because neither of us truly resisted until the very end.”
“…Yeah. I need to be more rational about this. I’m aware I’m drowning in pleasure…”
It was memorable how Father patted the panda’s shoulder with a firm gesture.
“At the very least, I’ll do my best to make sure Larsa can escape.”
“…Do you remember what that viper said when I tried to show any sign of escaping?”
“Huh? Wasn’t it something about someone named Elmero?”
“If that viper brings him in, you might end up broken, you know? Well… I’d like to think that viper has considered that to some extent.”
I think Father gulped audibly.
“Good morning, Father.”
After that, I subtly offered them some water.
“Ah, Motoyasu-kun, did you hear all that!?”
“I heard it loud and clear!”

When I cheerfully answered that, Father slumped down in defeat. Then, later that day, the sister of big Sister was full of energy from the morning, her skin looked moist and radiant, and she came down with a constant smile on her face.
“Alright! Let’s work even harder starting today! Come on, Naofumi-chan, make sure you eat something nutritious!”
“U-uh, okay.”
“You too, Sasa-chan!”
“Yeah, I guess.”
“Today… hmm, maybe we should invite Sakura-chan or Gaelion-chan along?”
“Hm? What’s going on?”
“N-no! You can’t do that! Sakura-chan and Gaelion-chan are just kids!”
“Oh my…”
Father spoke up firmly. A rare show of a strong tone from him.
“Let’s all stay strong and overcome any difficulties! I’ll be here to support you!”
That happened during the carriage ride to the Nosferatu Great Forest. Ren and Itsuki were watching the scene from a distance.

The next day, and the day after that, every morning, Father and the panda grew paler and more exhausted, while the sister of big Sister’s skin grew shinier by the day. They couldn’t escape, could they? If I recall correctly… Sakura-chan, who had been invited by the energetic sister of big Sister, was chased away by Father and put to sleep. I remember that clearly.
“Naofumi-chan, are you ready yet?”
“Ugh… can we rest tonight? Sadeena-san, you’re tired too, right?”
“I’m fine, I say. Look, Sasa-chan is waiting too.”
“N-no, I…”
“Oh my, Sasa-chan, you’re not being honest.”
The panda, hugged from behind by the sister of big Sister, looked at Father with a resentful expression and grabbed his hand.
“L-Larsa…?”
“I’m not letting you go.”
“Let me go! I… I want to live a more wholesome—”
“Come on! The night is just beginning!”
“Waaahhhhhh!”
Father and the panda were dragged into the room by the sister of big Sister. The next morning. The sister of big Sister’s skin looked even shinier than before.
“…Naofumi-san and Larsa-san’s life force is being drained. That’s what’s happening.”
“Yeah, no doubt about it.”
“Gaelion… wants to loop again…”

Ren and Itsuki started fussing about her being a succubus. I asked Father if everything was okay, and he said there was no problem. By noon, Father and the panda had recovered. It seems that’s how they’ve been spending their days.

I’ll just summarize what happened at the Nosferatu Great Forest. It wasn’t much different from the events on Cal Mira Island. It was a dense forest in the mountains. We passed through an unusual cliff on the way, a place where there was only one path, like a bridge. There was a large, circular cliff with a maze-like forest above the basin.

The large basin in the center was the base camp, connected to several other basins. It was best to imagine it like Cal Mira Island, where the basins formed something like individual islands. From the explanations of the rules and other factors, we concluded it was almost the same.
We were here to strengthen our forces until the seal of the Phoenix was broken. First, regarding the results of raising Luna-chan, the Filolial we thought was Luna-chan had different coloring.
“This is strange. This child should be Luna-chan.”
“…Huh?”
The personality was quite reserved, and the love for cute things was the same, but the feather colors were different. Even in her angelic form, it was the same. Everything was unified in one color.
“Imiya-chan, hug!”
“Wah! Uh, um…”

With Keel gone, Luna-chan seemed to have shifted her affection toward Mole. She was hugging it in her Filolial form. Probably because it was small and just the right size? No, it felt a little off from just liking cute things.
Moreover, her hobby was playing with dirt. Her desire for cute things was weaker than the Luna-chan I knew. Father also tilted his head after hearing the growth report of Luna-chan.
“Maybe something was different during the previous loop? I’m pretty sure that’s it.”
“But the Luna-chan I know has a slightly different personality. Even the scent is only similar.”
“Personality can change depending on the environment after birth. Sakura-chan is an example of that. And not having that Keel kid from the previous loop is a big factor.”
It’s painful to be reminded of Keel. It feels like our investigation has hit a dead end.
“Maybe it’s somehow related to Sakura-chan. I think the environment turns her into a Filolial like Filo…”
No, no, that’s impossible. The scent is a little different. Even the current Luna-chan (temporary name) smells different from the previous one.
